description: Each case: the bytes a proxy sent so far (reply as text, or reply_hex when not ASCII) and what the client makes of them: tunnel (any 2xx; leftover_hex: the bytes after the head, which are tunnel data), auth (407; schemes: the Proxy-Authenticate schemes, canonical names or other, each once), refused (any other status; code), malformed (not an HTTP/1.x reply head within 8192 bytes and 32 headers, decided as soon as the bytes show it) or incomplete (more bytes needed). Section 7; raven_protocol/connect.py
